name: implement-approved-story
description: Implements one explicitly approved, in-scope AML story and verifies the resulting change.
---

# Implement one approved story

Prerequisites: all upstream stages and the Sprint Plan have explicit human
approval. The user must name the single story to implement. Read its approved
acceptance criteria, relevant contracts, existing code, and repository
instructions before editing.

Make the smallest complete change that satisfies the story. Follow existing
patterns, preserve unrelated work, use only synthetic or appropriately
licensed public data, and keep all risk explanations and statuses aligned with
approved contracts. Do not add dependencies or expand scope without agreement.

Run the narrowest relevant available checks. Report files changed, acceptance
criteria covered, exact commands and results, limitations, and any design
mismatch. Stop for human review; do not merge or start another story.
